newsitem.title: USA: Prisoners slip away from work detail for beer, sex.
newsitem.headline: Prisoners slip away from work detail for beer, sex.

text.p: Six unsupervised prison inmates landed in hot water after slipping away from a roadside work detail to drink beer and have sex with a local woman, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported on Friday.

The prisoners, all minimum-security inmates, were left on their own by a prison guard while laying down hay alongside a road near the Carroll County Correctional Facility in west Georgia. The guard and another inmate had left them there while going off to fetch gravel.
A woman living in a nearby trailer initially said four of the prisoners raped her while two others watched, but she later withdrew the charges, according to state officials.
The inmates told prison officials that the woman had called to them from her front-door step and offered them beer.
The blood-alcohol level of one prisoner measured 0.12, which was beyond the limit set by the state for declaring someone drunk.
State prison officials said the Carroll County guard assigned to watch the work detail was allowed to leave the minimum-security inmates unsupervised for up to an hour.
But with a police investigation into the incident under way, prison officials said the inmates would be moved to state supervision.
